fn rs_global(stage: *RsStage, name: *RmdName) -> *RsGlobal {
    return rmd_map_get(&(*stage).globals, name as usize) as *RsGlobal;
}

fn rs_indirect(syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> bool {
    return (*syntax).kind == RMD_T_NAME || (*syntax).kind == RMD_T_ARRAY;
}

fn rs_pointer(stage: *RsStage, base: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    var result: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_POINTER, &(*base).loc);
    if result != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { (*result).base = base; }
    return result;
}

fn rs_lower_type(stage: *RsStage, source: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    if source == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) || (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    var found: *RmdTypeSyntax = rmd_map_get(&(*stage).lowered_types, source as usize) as *RmdTypeSyntax;
    if found != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return found; }
    var kind: u32 = (*source).kind;
    var target: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, kind, &(*source).loc);
    if target == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return target; }
    *target = *source;
    rs_put(stage, &(*stage).lowered_types, source as usize, target as *u8);
    if kind == RS_READ || kind == RS_MUT {
        if (*(*source).base).kind == RS_READ || (*(*source).base).kind == RS_MUT {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "borrow modes require a value type, not another borrow mode");
            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
        (*target).kind = RMD_T_POINTER;
        (*target).base = rs_lower_type(stage, (*source).base);
    } else { if kind == RMD_T_POINTER || kind == RMD_T_ARRAY {
        if (*(*source).base).kind == RS_READ || (*(*source).base).kind == RS_MUT {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "borrow types cannot be stored in pointers or arrays");
            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
        (*target).base = rs_lower_type(stage, (*source).base);
    } else { if kind == RMD_T_FUNCTION {
        var result: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*source).base;
        if (*result).kind == RS_READ || (*result).kind == RS_MUT {
            rs_error(stage, &(*result).loc, "function results cannot be borrowed views");
            return null(*RmdTypeSyntax);
        }
        var count: usize = (*source).param_count;
        var by_address: bool = rs_indirect(result);
        (*target).param_count = count;
        if by_address { (*target).param_count = count + 1usize; }
        (*target).params = rs_alloc(stage, (*target).param_count * sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
        if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
        var index: usize = 0usize;
        while index < count && !(*stage).failed {
            var parameter: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*source).params[index];
            var lowered: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_lower_type(stage, parameter);
            if rs_indirect(parameter) && lowered != null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { lowered = rs_pointer(stage, lowered); }
            (*target).params[index] = lowered;
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
        (*target).base = rs_lower_type(stage, result);
        if by_address && !(*stage).failed {
            (*target).base = rs_pointer(stage, (*target).base);
            (*target).params[count] = (*target).base;
        }
    } } }
    return target;
}

fn rs_storage_type(stage: *RsStage, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> *RmdType {
    var lowered: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_lower_type(stage, syntax);
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdType); }
    var result: *RmdType = rmd_try_resolve_type((*stage).context, lowered);
    if result == null(*RmdType) { (*stage).failed = true; }
    return result;
}

fn rs_same(stage: *RsStage, a: *RmdTypeSyntax, b: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> bool {
    if (*stage).failed || a == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) || b == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return false; }
    if (*a).kind != (*b).kind { return false; }
    if (*a).kind == RS_READ || (*a).kind == RS_MUT || (*a).kind == RMD_T_POINTER || (*a).kind == RMD_T_ARRAY {
        if (*a).kind == RMD_T_ARRAY && (*a).count != (*b).count { return false; }
        return rs_same(stage, (*a).base, (*b).base);
    }
    if (*a).kind == RMD_T_NAME { return (*a).name == (*b).name; }
    if (*a).kind == RMD_T_FUNCTION {
        if (*a).param_count != (*b).param_count || !rs_same(stage, (*a).base, (*b).base) { return false; }
        var index: usize = 0usize;
        while index < (*a).param_count {
            if !rs_same(stage, (*a).params[index], (*b).params[index]) { return false; }
            index = index + 1usize;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

fn rs_owns(stage: *RsStage, syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax) -> bool {
    if (*stage).failed { return false; }
    if (*syntax).kind == RMD_T_ARRAY { return rs_owns(stage, (*syntax).base); }
    if (*syntax).kind != RMD_T_NAME { return false; }
    var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*syntax).name);
    if global == null(*RsGlobal) || (*(*global).source).kind != RMD_D_RECORD {
        rs_error(stage, &(*syntax).loc, "expected a declared record type");
        return false;
    }
    var state: usize = rmd_map_get(&(*stage).ownership, global as usize) as usize;
    if state == 1usize { return false; }
    if state == 2usize { return true; }
    if state == 3usize {
        rs_error(stage, &(*syntax).loc, "resource layout contains a value cycle");
        return false;
    }
    rs_put(stage, &(*stage).ownership, global as usize, 3usize as *u8);
    var owns: bool = (*global).resource != null(*RsResource);
    var field: *RmdField = (*(*global).source).fields;
    while field != null(*RmdField) && !(*stage).failed {
        if rs_owns(stage, (*field).syntax_type) { owns = true; }
        field = (*field).next;
    }
    state = 1usize;
    if owns { state = 2usize; }
    rs_put(stage, &(*stage).ownership, global as usize, state as *u8);
    return owns;
}

fn rs_signature(stage: *RsStage, declaration: *RmdDecl) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    var signature: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_type_node(stage, RMD_T_FUNCTION, &(*declaration).loc);
    if signature == null(*RmdTypeSyntax) { return signature; }
    (*signature).base = (*declaration).syntax_type;
    var parameter: *RmdParam = (*declaration).params;
    var count: usize = 0usize;
    while parameter != null(*RmdParam) { count = count + 1usize; parameter = (*parameter).next; }
    (*signature).param_count = count;
    (*signature).params = rs_alloc(stage, count * sizeof(*RmdTypeSyntax), alignof(*RmdTypeSyntax)) as **RmdTypeSyntax;
    if (*stage).failed { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); }
    parameter = (*declaration).params;
    count = 0usize;
    while parameter != null(*RmdParam) {
        (*signature).params[count] = (*parameter).syntax_type;
        count = count + 1usize;
        parameter = (*parameter).next;
    }
    return signature;
}

fn rs_collect(stage: *RsStage) -> bool {
    (*stage).sources = (*(*stage).context).units;
    var unit_value: *RmdUnit = (*stage).sources;
    while unit_value != null(*RmdUnit) && !(*stage).failed {
        var declaration: *RmdDecl = (*unit_value).declarations;
        while declaration != null(*RmdDecl) && !(*stage).failed {
            if rs_global(stage, (*declaration).name) != null(*RsGlobal) {
                rs_error(stage, &(*declaration).loc, "duplicate declaration");
                return false;
            }
            var global: *RsGlobal = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RsGlobal), alignof(RsGlobal)) as *RsGlobal;
            if global == null(*RsGlobal) { return false; }
            (*global).source = declaration;
            (*global).syntax = (*declaration).syntax_type;
            if (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION || (*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN {
                (*global).syntax = rs_signature(stage, declaration);
                (*global).unsafe_call = ((*declaration).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN &&
                    rmd_map_get(&(*stage).source_imports, declaration as usize) == null(*u8)) ||
                    rmd_map_get(&(*stage).unsafe_functions, declaration as usize) != null(*u8);
            }
            rs_put(stage, &(*stage).globals, (*declaration).name as usize, global as *u8);
            if (*stage).first_global == null(*RsGlobal) { (*stage).first_global = global; }
            else { (*(*stage).last_global).next = global; }
            (*stage).last_global = global;
            declaration = (*declaration).next;
        }
        unit_value = (*unit_value).next;
    }
    var resource: *RsResource = (*stage).resources;
    while resource != null(*RsResource) && !(*stage).failed {
        var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*(*resource).declaration).name);
        (*global).resource = resource;
        (*global).drop = rs_global(stage, (*resource).drop_name);
        var drop: *RsGlobal = (*global).drop;
        if drop == null(*RsGlobal) || (*drop).unsafe_call ||
           ((*(*drop).source).kind != RMD_D_FUNCTION &&
            rmd_map_get(&(*stage).source_imports, (*drop).source as usize) == null(*u8)) {
            rs_error(stage, &(*(*resource).declaration).loc, "resource drop must name a safe defined function or source ABI import");
            return false;
        }
        var signature: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*drop).syntax;
        if (*signature).param_count != 1usize || (*(*signature).base).kind != RMD_T_UNIT {
            rs_error(stage, &(*(*drop).source).loc, "drop requires one mut resource parameter and a unit result");
            return false;
        }
        var parameter: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*signature).params[0usize];
        if (*parameter).kind != RS_MUT || (*(*parameter).base).kind != RMD_T_NAME ||
           (*(*parameter).base).name != (*(*global).source).name {
            rs_error(stage, &(*parameter).loc, "drop parameter must borrow its resource exclusively");
            return false;
        }
        (*drop).drop_only = true;
        resource = (*resource).next;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}

fn rs_publish(stage: *RsStage) -> bool {
    var context: *RmdContext = (*stage).context;
    (*context).units = null(*RmdUnit);
    (*context).last_unit = null(*RmdUnit);
    var source_unit: *RmdUnit = (*stage).sources;
    while source_unit != null(*RmdUnit) && !(*stage).failed {
        var target_unit: *RmdUnit = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdUnit), alignof(RmdUnit)) as *RmdUnit;
        if target_unit == null(*RmdUnit) { return false; }
        (*target_unit).source = (*source_unit).source;
        if (*context).units == null(*RmdUnit) { (*context).units = target_unit; }
        else { (*(*context).last_unit).next = target_unit; }
        (*context).last_unit = target_unit;
        var source: *RmdDecl = (*source_unit).declarations;
        var last: *RmdDecl = null(*RmdDecl);
        while source != null(*RmdDecl) && !(*stage).failed {
            var global: *RsGlobal = rs_global(stage, (*source).name);
            var target: *RmdDecl = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdDecl), alignof(RmdDecl)) as *RmdDecl;
            if target == null(*RmdDecl) { return false; }
            *target = *source;
            (*target).next = null(*RmdDecl);
            (*target).body = null(*RmdStmt);
            (*global).lowered = target;
            if last == null(*RmdDecl) { (*target_unit).declarations = target; }
            else { (*last).next = target; }
            last = target;
            if (*source).kind == RMD_D_RECORD {
                (*target).fields = null(*RmdField);
                var field: *RmdField = (*source).fields;
                var previous: *RmdField = null(*RmdField);
                while field != null(*RmdField) && !(*stage).failed {
                    if (*(*field).syntax_type).kind == RS_READ || (*(*field).syntax_type).kind == RS_MUT {
                        rs_error(stage, &(*field).loc, "borrowed views cannot be record fields");
                        return false;
                    }
                    var copy: *RmdField = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdField), alignof(RmdField)) as *RmdField;
                    if copy == null(*RmdField) { return false; }
                    *copy = *field;
                    (*copy).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, (*field).syntax_type);
                    (*copy).next = null(*RmdField);
                    if previous == null(*RmdField) { (*target).fields = copy; }
                    else { (*previous).next = copy; }
                    previous = copy;
                    field = (*field).next;
                }
            } else { if (*source).kind == RMD_D_FUNCTION || (*source).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN {
                var signature: *RmdTypeSyntax = rs_lower_type(stage, (*global).syntax);
                if (*stage).failed { return false; }
                (*target).syntax_type = (*signature).base;
                (*target).params = null(*RmdParam);
                var source_param: *RmdParam = (*source).params;
                var last_param: *RmdParam = null(*RmdParam);
                var index: usize = 0usize;
                while index < (*signature).param_count && !(*stage).failed {
                    var parameter: *RmdParam = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RmdParam), alignof(RmdParam)) as *RmdParam;
                    if parameter == null(*RmdParam) { return false; }
                    (*parameter).loc = (*source).loc;
                    (*parameter).name = rs_name(stage);
                    (*parameter).syntax_type = (*signature).params[index];
                    if source_param != null(*RmdParam) {
                        (*parameter).loc = (*source_param).loc;
                        source_param = (*source_param).next;
                    }
                    if last_param == null(*RmdParam) { (*target).params = parameter; }
                    else { (*last_param).next = parameter; }
                    last_param = parameter;
                    index = index + 1usize;
                }
                if (*source).kind == RMD_D_EXTERN &&
                   rmd_map_get(&(*stage).source_imports, source as usize) == null(*u8) {
                    index = 0usize;
                    while index < (*(*global).syntax).param_count {
                        var parameter: *RmdTypeSyntax = (*(*global).syntax).params[index];
                        if rs_indirect(parameter) || (*parameter).kind == RS_READ || (*parameter).kind == RS_MUT {
                            rs_error(stage, &(*parameter).loc, "foreign signatures require explicit scalar ABI types");
                            return false;
                        }
                        index = index + 1usize;
                    }
                    if rs_indirect((*(*global).syntax).base) {
                        rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "foreign results require an explicit scalar ABI type");
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (*(*source).syntax_type).kind == RS_READ ||
                   (*(*source).syntax_type).kind == RS_MUT {
                    rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "global constants cannot own resources or local views");
                    return false;
                }
                (*target).syntax_type = rs_lower_type(stage, (*source).syntax_type);
                (*target).init = rs_lower_constant(stage, (*source).init);
                if (*stage).failed { return false; }
            } }
            source = (*source).next;
        }
        source_unit = (*source_unit).next;
    }
    if (*stage).failed { return false; }
    if !rmd_collect(context) || !rmd_resolve(context) { (*stage).failed = true; return false; }
    var global: *RsGlobal = (*stage).first_global;
    while global != null(*RsGlobal) && !(*stage).failed {
        var source: *RmdDecl = (*global).source;
        if (*source).kind == RMD_D_CONST && rs_owns(stage, (*source).syntax_type) {
            rs_error(stage, &(*source).loc, "global constants cannot own resources or local views");
        }
        global = (*global).next;
    }
    return !(*stage).failed;
}
